CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  JULY 25, 2026

A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Torosis at 8:31 a.m., on
Saturday, July 25, 2026, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA.

Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Caroline Torosis
  Councilmember Lana Negrete
  Councilmember Dan Hall
  Councilmember Ellis Raskin
  Councilmember Barry Snell (arrived at I 1:20 a.m.)
  Councilmember Natalya Zemitskaya (arrived at 8:33)

  Absent:  Mayor Pro Tern Jesse Zwick

  Also Present:  City Manager Oliver Chi
  City Attorney Heidi von Tongeln
  Interim City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 8:31 a.m., with all
  members present except Councilmembers Snell, Zernitskaya, and Mayor Pro
  Tern Zwick. Mayor Torosis led the assemblage in the Pledge of Allegiance.

STATEMENT OF  The City of Santa Monica Statement of Accountability (Land
ACCOUNTABILITY  Acknowledgement) was read into the record by Councilmember Raskin.
(LAND
ACKNOWLEDGEMENT)

LEVINE ACT  No Councilmembers made disclosures regarding the Levine Act (Govt Code
DISCLOSURE  Section 84308).

PUBLIC INPUT ON  There were no members of the public present to comment on Closed Session.
